summary: Complete frontend testing of Share Estimation feature for IPP and AAH calculators. All 12 share feature tests passed. Share buttons (WhatsApp, SMS, Email, Copy link) appear correctly in result sections. Auto-calculate from URL params works for both calculators. Copy button shows 'Copié !' confirmation.
passed_tests: IPP Calculator: Share buttons (WhatsApp, SMS, Email, Copy link) appear after clicking 'Calculer l'estimation'
IPP Calculator: 'Copier le lien' button copies URL and shows 'Copié !' confirmation
IPP Calculator: Shared link auto-calculates - /calculatrice-ipp?t=5 shows 2,222€ capital result
IPP Calculator: Shared link auto-calculates - /calculatrice-ipp?t=30&s=30000 shows 4,500€/year rente
IPP Calculator: WhatsApp button opens wa.me with correct encoded text and URL
IPP Calculator: SMS button triggers sms: protocol link
IPP Calculator: Email button triggers mailto: with subject and body
AAH Calculator: Share buttons (WhatsApp, SMS, Email, Copy link) appear after calculating
AAH Calculator: 'Copier le lien' button shows 'Copié !' confirmation
AAH Calculator: Shared link auto-calculates - /calculatrice-aah?t=80&sf=seul&r=0&e=0 shows 971.37€
AAH Calculator: Shared link with couple and children - /calculatrice-aah?t=80&sf=couple&r=500&e=2 shows result and selects couple
AAH Calculator: Share buttons appear for non-eligible results (taux=30, <50%)
critical_code_review_comments: Share feature well-implemented with proper URL encoding for WhatsApp, SMS, and Email
URL params correctly parsed via useSearchParams with auto-calculation on page load
Copy button has good UX with visual feedback ('Copié !' text and checkmark icon)
Share buttons styled consistently with appropriate brand colors (WhatsApp green, blue for SMS, accent for Email)
All share buttons have proper data-testid attributes for testing
seed_data_creation: None required - calculators are client-side only
context_for_next_testing_agent: Share estimation feature fully tested and working. IPP uses params t (taux) and s (salaire for taux>=10). AAH uses params t (taux), sf (situation familiale: seul/couple), r (revenus), e (enfants). WhatsApp opens https://wa.me/?text=..., SMS uses sms:?body=..., Email uses mailto:?subject=...&body=.... Copy button uses navigator.clipboard.writeText().
